summary.intent: Investigate and fix miscounted Codex token usage totals being displayed/stored by the Entire CLI.
summary.outcome: Identified that Codex reports cached_input_tokens as a subset of input_tokens (and reasoning_output_tokens as a subset of output_tokens), while the code was treating them as additive. Fixed the normalization in the Codex transcript parser, added regression tests, and committed the change on branch fix/codex-token-counts. The PR push was not shown in the transcript.

repo: The shared agent.TokenUsage model is additive (InputTokens + CacheCreationTokens + CacheReadTokens + OutputTokens = total) and has no TotalTokens field; display/reporting sums the components.

Codex uses inclusive fields (cached_input_tokens ⊂ input_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens ⊂ output_tokens, total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens), requiring a normalization step before entering the shared model — unlike Claude which uses separate additive buckets.

TestGroupCommitsByDay_SortsNewestFirst is a pre-existing timezone-sensitive test that fails under Australia/Melbourne local time because UTC timestamps straddle midnight differently; it passes under TZ=UTC.
mise run check runs gofmt, golangci-lint, integration/race tests, and deterministic E2E canaries (Vogon agent); mise run test is the unit-only path.
Codex transcript token_count events include both cumulative and per-step (last_token_usage) fields; checkpoint-scoped deltas require subtracting a baseline.

code.finding: Normalization of Codex inclusive token fields into Entire's additive model: InputTokens = input_tokens_delta - cached_input_tokens_delta, CacheReadTokens = cached_input_tokens_delta, OutputTokens = output_tokens_delta.
New regression tests assert that summed Entire fields equal Codex's total_tokens, including the checkpoint-offset (delta) case.
Shared TokenUsage struct has no TotalTokens field; total is always computed by summing component fields, so any agent feeding this model must use additive (non-overlapping) buckets.

workflow: TDD was used: failing tests encoding the correct invariant were written before touching production code, confirming the overcount before fixing it.
Codex's own total_tokens field serves as a useful test oracle to validate normalization correctness.
Sandbox permission issues blocking Go build cache required re-running commands with escalation; this was a recurring pattern across multiple mise runs.
Staged only the two relevant files (transcript.go, transcript_test.go) explicitly to avoid including the pre-existing unrelated .opencode/package-lock.json change.

friction: Sandbox blocked Go build cache writes multiple times, requiring escalated reruns of mise run check and mise run test.
Pre-existing timezone-sensitive test failure (TestGroupCommitsByDay_SortsNewestFirst) polluted full suite runs in Melbourne local time, requiring TZ=UTC workaround.
Unrelated gofmt issue in .worktrees/2/.../common_test.go caused mise run lint to fail even though golangci-lint itself reported 0 issues.

Two competing Codex transcript token formats exist in-tree (payload-level fields vs info.total_token_usage), requiring careful investigation to determine which the current CLI version (0.124.0) actually emits.
open_items: Pre-existing bug: TestGroupCommitsByDay_SortsNewestFirst uses t.Local() and fails in non-UTC timezones (e.g. Australia/Melbourne); needs fix to use UTC timestamps in test fixtures.
